answer: The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, converted to a slow vesting stream. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Every claim climbs the raven of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the opal re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. What survives to the quartz is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
